description: Result of seeding: per chosen-lane, a Steve sub-session UUID + a resume command the user can paste to wake it. The CREATE seam of onboard-v0. Apoha: the Steve is BLANK at this point — identity precipitates from its audit stream downstream, not from this artifact.

input_refs.description: Reference to the seed-selection this instantiation realizes.

sub_sessions.description: One sub-session per lane in seed-selection.chosen_lanes.

lane.description: Lane slug — matches one of seed-selection.chosen_lanes.

session_uuid.description: Opaque per-Steve UUID. NOT a name.

resume_command.description: Concrete shell command to resume this Steve, e.g. `claude --resume <uuid>`.
